_source: Pre-first-run fallback only: the pipeline recomputes this per chamber every run (score_calculator.compute_funding_reference) and writes /data/funding_reference.json, which takes precedence. Values are the 2026-07 audits previously hand-typed into score_calculator.py: PAC-share medians (scripts/audit_pac_ratio.py; the multipliers 3.2 Senate / 1.35 House were 0.5 / median, measured over receipts before v6.13 moved to contributions), the fallback PAC-dollar median ($662,750, n=532, both chambers pooled) and top-donor concentration p10/median/p90 (21.2%/27.8%/38.3%, n=453, pooled; per-chamber medians 30.5% Senate / 27.5% House). The first pipeline run replaces them with per-chamber measurements. Regenerate with backend/scripts/audit_pac_ratio.py. small_donor_p10/median/p90 are placeholders centred on small_donor_baseline.json's national mean (18.62%) with its saturation spread (21.2 pts) — no per-chamber small-donor distribution was ever measured before v6.13; the first pipeline run replaces them.
